source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Public Data API v2 (unregistered access, pulled 2026-09-11)
series_black: LNS14000006 — Black/African American Unemployment Rate (seasonally adjusted, monthly)
series_white: LNS14000003 — White Unemployment Rate (seasonally adjusted, monthly)
coverage: 1972-01 through 2025-11 (647 months; December 2025 not yet published at pull time)

key_findings.summary: Black monthly unemployment was never below white monthly unemployment in any of the 647 months. Closest approach: 2020-04, ratio 1.190.

note: Ingested 2026-09-11 to document the monthly no-inversion claim. All 54 annual values in bls_unemployment_by_race_1972-2025_FULL_RAW.json recompute as means of these monthly observations (2025 from 11 months).
